item.title: James Gunn's Firing Reveals Kevin Feige's Secret Superpower, and It's Not the Avengers
item.description: Anyone who pays even a small amount of attention to the superhero movie industry is likely experiencing déjà vu this week. On Monday, Nov. 9, news broke that, after buying Warner Bros. for $110 billion (and DC with it), Skydance CEO and nepo baby supreme David Ellison had fired James Gunn and Peter Safran from their roles as co-CEOs of DC Studios. And so, the cycle begins again. To paraphrase a classic Warner Bros. movie , "This will be the third time we have rebooted the DC cinematic universe, and we have become exceedingly efficient at it."

item.title: New Fortnite Leak Reveals Official Shrek Collab May Be Coming
item.description: This Thursday, Fortnite launched the first update of the One Piece mini-season, introducing new characters, sprites, and items. Leakers dug through the game files in hopes of finding some juicy information on upcoming content or more details on obtaining the Pirate Shop Access token . Instead, they came across a particularly interesting encrypted file for a Fortnite sidekick, and its description matched a character from Shrek.

item.title: Epic Makes Kirby-inspired Roguelike Completely Free for a Limited Time
item.description: The Epic Games Store is offering a great free PC game this week for users. For a limited time, you can grab a roguelike tower defense game at no charge.

item.title: Shibuya Crossing location in Forza Horizon 6
item.description: Shibuya Crossing is a Discovery location and one of the most iconic real-life landmarks that appear in Forza Horizon 6 .

item.title: Pokémon Legends: Z-A Is Giving Away 2 Free Shiny Legendaries
item.description: Holiday season is right around the corner, and Game Freak has an early present for Pokémon players. It will be giving away two shiny versions of the legendary Pokémon Xerneas and Yveltal in Pokémon Legends: Z-A over the next couple of months.

item.title: James Gunn’s DC Exit Has ‘Renewed Hope’ for a Cult-Favorite Superhero Sequel
item.description: The sudden exit of DC Studios co-heads James Gunn and Peter Safran this week has cast doubt on the fate of several projects the two had in the works. Gunn's Superman follow-up, Man of Tomorrow , is still planned for release next year, but everything beyond that is up in the air. The shake-up could be good news for one long-awaited project, however. Director Francis Lawrence believes his Constantine 2 is more likely than ever.

item.title: What if the games children love were designed to help them thrive?
item.description: UNICEF’s Responsible Innovation in Technology for Children (RITEC) initiative helps harness creativity and expertise to support their well-being.

item.title: Nintendo Officially Announces Black Friday 2026 Deals on Switch 2 Hardware and Games
item.description: Nintendo has officially revealed its Black Friday deals for 2026, giving frugal-minded holiday shoppers an opportunity to get a pair of Nintendo Switch 2 system bundles at a discount. Nintendo is also putting select digital and physical games for Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 on sale, with discounts on games such as Super Mario Party Jamboree and Metroid Prime 4: Beyond .

item.title: Marvel’s WWII Game Not Canceled, but Sounds Like a Mess, Insiders Say
item.description: One of the biggest upcoming Marvel games has lived to fight another day. According to an X post from Bloomberg reporter Jason Schreier, Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra has not been canceled, despite rumors to the contrary.

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Amid Alleged Spying Scandal
item.description: After weeks of headlines about an affair with an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down from his leadership position at the computer hardware company. Nvidia announced the decision on Thursday morning in a press release that described the company's next steps. Replacing Huang is Colette Kress, the current executive vice president and chief financial officer of Nvidia. Kress will be serving in an interim capacity until Nvidia finds a permanent successor.
